name: Sudhabala Thailam (Oil)

sections.overview:
Sudhabala Thailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Refernece: Sahasrayogam taiyong 
 Sudhabala Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic herbal oil. This is used in treatment of neurological conditions. It is used for external application as in massage and also for oral administration.
sections.ingredients:
Bala moola – root of Sida cordifolia – 480 grams 
 Tila taila – sesame oil – 3.072 ml 
 Balamoola kashaya – water deocoction of Bala root – 4800 ml. 
 Cow Milk – 6.144 ml 

 Method of Preparation 
 The above combination is heated till the herbal oil is formed. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sudhabala Thailam is quiet useful Ayurvedic formulated oil having medicinal properties to supports muscles and nerves. It is very useful to deal with Neurological conditions. It provides effective results when used in hemiplegic and paraplegic conditions, where it helps to restore motor and sensory functions of the brain and improves the blood circulation. This is even helpful in providing relief from the symptoms appearing in neuralgia, provides relief to sufferers of neuralgia, and lessen severe neuralgia pain. 
 An efficient Ayurvedic oil for managing the facial palsy, improves the facial movements and provides relief from pain and discomfort as well good to use in insanity. 
 It is also very helpful in women in pregnancy and even useful in puerperium (post delivery period), able to manage problems arising. 
 This is suitable for improving joint functions too, helps to recover the movements in the joints. It is even useful to manage eye diseases.
sections.how_to_use: Orally, it is usually administered in a dose of 2 – 10 drops once or twice a day before food with luke warm water or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor.
sections.side_effects:
It is best to use this medicine strictly under medical supervision. 
 Patients with high cholesterol and high blood pressure should take extra precaution. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

 Refernece: Sahasrayogam taiyong 
 Sudhabala Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic herbal oil. This is used in treatment of neurological conditions. It is used for external application as in massage and also for oral administration. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Bala moola – root of Sida cordifolia – 480 grams 
 Tila taila – sesame oil – 3.072 ml 
 Balamoola kashaya – water deocoction of Bala root – 4800 ml. 
 Cow Milk – 6.144 ml 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The above combination is heated till the herbal oil is formed. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sudhabala Thailam is quiet useful Ayurvedic formulated oil having medicinal properties to supports muscles and nerves. It is very useful to deal with Neurological conditions. It provides effective results when used in hemiplegic and paraplegic conditions, where it helps to restore motor and sensory functions of the brain and improves the blood circulation. This is even helpful in providing relief from the symptoms appearing in neuralgia, provides relief to sufferers of neuralgia, and lessen severe neuralgia pain. 
 An efficient Ayurvedic oil for managing the facial palsy, improves the facial movements and provides relief from pain and discomfort as well good to use in insanity. 
 It is also very helpful in women in pregnancy and even useful in puerperium (post delivery period), able to manage problems arising. 
 This is suitable for improving joint functions too, helps to recover the movements in the joints. It is even useful to manage eye diseases. 
 Indications 
 
 Hemiplegia 
 Paraplegia 
 Neuralgia 
 
 How to use? 
 Orally, it is usually administered in a dose of 2 – 10 drops once or twice a day before food with luke warm water or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor.

 It is best to use this medicine strictly under medical supervision. 
 Patients with high cholesterol and high blood pressure should take extra precaution.
